hunchouen: Junchowen — Hunchouen; name of the second son of Hunhunahpu; jun 'one' + chowen, a day name; kept as a name
xbaquiyalo: Xb'akiyalo — Xbaquiyalo; name of the wife of Hunhunahpu; x- marks a woman's name, the rest unclear (Brasseur, after Ximénez: 'bound bones', b'aq 'bone' + yal); kept as a name
quetamabal: ketamab'al — their knowledge; k- 'their' (ki- before a vowel) + etamab'al 'knowledge', from etamaj 'know'
yaqueic: yakeik — (guess) bearing, ways; not otherwise known, taken from its pairing with k'oje'ik 'being' (Brasseur 'coutumes')
xquicutu: xkik'utu — they showed (it); x- completive + ki- 'they' + k'utu, the verb k'ut 'show' (as in uk'utunisaxik); Ximénez's plain c is respelled k' because the word is known
nauiquil: nawikil — (inferred) all knowledge, every art; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('the whole of knowledge') and the list of crafts that follows it

ahcot: ajkot — carver; aj- 'one who' + kot 'carve'; the plain k is kept (Brasseur's q suggests k'ot, undecided)
ahxit: ajxit — jeweller, worker of precious stones; aj- 'one who' + xit 'jade, precious stone'
ahpuvac: ajpuwaq — silversmith, worker of metal; aj- 'one who' + puwaq 'silver, metal'
vcub: Wuqub' — Seven; wuqub' 'seven' in the name Wuqub' Junajpu, written here with a single v (elsewhere vvcub)
cacab: kakab' — (inferred) two by two; a doubling of kab' 'two'; the b is clear in the manuscript (Brasseur cacap)
culelaah: kulelaaj — (guess) face (each other), with kib' 'one another'; not otherwise known, perhaps from kulel 'opponent'
cuchmaihic: kuchmaijik — (inferred) gathering, coming together; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('se réunissaient')
hom: jom — ball court; noun, the walled alley of the ball game (Brasseur: the hall of the ball game, Nahuatl tlachco)
voc: Wok — the Voc; a bird, a hawk (Ximénez's gloss 'gavilán'), the messenger of Huracan; kept as a name

libahchi: lib'ajchi — (inferred) quickly, in an instant; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('en un moment')
chopon: chopon — he arrives (there); ch- + opon 'arrive (there)' (Brasseur ch'opon)
yaluh: yaluj — (inferred) stay long, remain; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('tandis qu'ils demeuraient'; he gives yaloh 'separate, hold back, stay')
xcaminac: xkaminaq — had died, dead; x- + kaminaq, kam 'die' + -inaq, the perfect
xquita: xkita — they heard; x- completive + ki- 'they' + ta 'hear'

came: Kame — Came, Death; kam 'die', the day Death (Brasseur), in Wuqub' Kame 'Seven Death', a lord of Xibalba; kept as a name
rahaual: rajawal — its lords, the lords of; r- 'its' + ajaw 'lord' + -al
naqui: naqi — what; interrogative, written with pa as naqi pa 'what is it'
caban: kab'an — it is done (inferred, with a passive sense); k- 'ongoing' + b'an 'do'
micnohic: miknojik — (guess) stamping, shaking; not otherwise known, paired with juminik; 'stamp and clamour' is guessed from Brasseur's 'who make it tremble' and the noise of the ball game
huminic: juminik — (guess) clamouring, raising a tumult; not otherwise known, paired with miknojik; after Brasseur ('who raise such a tumult')
quebe: keb'e — let them go; ke 'they' + b'e 'go', written as one word
tacoc: taqoq — be summoned, be sent for; taq 'send, send for' + -oq (Brasseur tak-oc, his k standing for q)
vl: ul — come, arrive here; verb, the root of kul and chul
chac: chak — (inferred) beat, defeat; after Brasseur ('afin que nous les vainquions'); the modern verb 'win' is ch'ak, but the word is uncertain and the ejective is not restored

cuxic: quxik — our being; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + uxik 'being'; Brasseur k'uxic, his k standing for q
hiquic: jikik — (guess) brawling, fighting; not otherwise known, 'brawl' after Brasseur ('se batailler')
conoh: konoj — all of them; short for konojel (Brasseur's note)
catol: q'atol — cutter, judge; agent noun of q'at 'cut, decide' + -ol, as in q'atol tzij 'cutter of the word'

rahauarem: rajawarem — his lordship, his rule; r- 'his' + ajawarem, ajaw 'lord' + -arem, an abstract noun
xiquiripat: Xikiripat — Xiquiripat; name of a lord of Xibalba, paired with Kuchumakik; Brasseur 'flying basket' (hotte volante); kept as a name
cuchumaquic: Kuchumakik — Cuchumaquic; name of a lord of Xibalba; Brasseur 'gathered blood' (cuchuma + kik'); kept as a name
quic: kik' — blood; noun, the known word, with the ejective restored (Brasseur quiq) · kik' — (inferred) rubber, the ball of rubber; the same word as 'blood', after Brasseur ('balls of elastic gum')
ahalpuh: Ajalpuj — Ahalpuh; name of a lord of Xibalba, taken as 'Maker of Pus' (aj- + -al + puj 'pus', after Brasseur); inferred, kept as a name
ahalꜫana: Ajalq'ana — Ahalq'ana; name of a lord of Xibalba, taken as 'Maker of Yellow' (aj- + -al + q'ana, after Brasseur); inferred, kept as a name
cahauarem: kajawarem — their lordship; k- 'their' (ki- before a vowel) + ajawarem
chuꜫanal: Chuq'anal — Chuq'anal; a yellowing sickness, which Brasseur calls a kind of jaundice (inferred, from q'an 'yellow'); kept as a name
chamiabac: Chamiab'aq — Chamiabac; name of a lord of Xibalba, chamia + b'aq 'bone', 'Bone Staff' (Brasseur's reading); kept as a name
chamiaholom: Chamiajolom — Chamiaholom; name of a lord of Xibalba, chamia + jolom 'head, skull', 'Skull Staff' (Brasseur's reading); kept as a name
rahchami: rajchami — its staff-bearers; r- 'its' + aj- 'one who' + chami(y) 'staff'; Brasseur: the officers the Spaniards called alguaciles
chamiy: chamiy — staff, rod; noun, the staff an officer carries
cahchamiyal: kajchamiyal — their staff-office; k- 'their' + aj- + chamiy 'staff' + -al
baquir: b'aqir — grow bony, become bone; b'aq 'bone' + -ir 'become'
ꜩiyah: tziyaj — (uncertain) meaning unknown; in tziyaj b'aq 'bare bone (?)', read after Brasseur's 'only a skeleton' (guess)
pan: pan — (uncertain) not otherwise known; read with tziyaj after Brasseur as 'only a skeleton to take up' (guess)
camouic: k'amowik — (inferred) taking up; k'am 'take' + -ow- + -ik, the form of xk'amowik, not kam 'die'; Brasseur qamouic, 'to take up'
chamiyabac: Chamiyab'aq — Chamiyabac; the same name as Chamiab'aq written with the y of chamiy 'staff'; chamiy + b'aq 'bone'; kept as a name
chamiyaholom: Chamiyajolom — Chamiyaholom; the same name as Chamiajolom written with the y of chamiy 'staff'; chamiy + jolom 'head, skull'; kept as a name
ahalmez: Ajalmes — Ahalmez; name of a lord of Xibalba, taken as 'Maker of Filth' (aj- + -al + mes 'sweepings, rubbish', after Brasseur); inferred, kept as a name
ahaltocob: Ajaltoq'ob' — Ahaltocob; name of a lord of Xibalba, taken as 'Maker of Misery' (aj- + -al + toq'ob' 'pity, misery', after Brasseur); inferred, kept as a name
culvachih: kulwachij — (inferred) meet face to face; kul 'meet' + wach 'face' + -ij; after Brasseur ('faire trouver l'homme en face')
vve: uwe — if, whether; we 'if' written vv (Brasseur divides u ve); the first v is not explained (uncertain)
ꜩamez: tzames — (uncertain) not otherwise known; Brasseur 'avec la trahison'
chuva: chuwa — (inferred) at the front of, in front of; chi + u- 'its' + wa 'front, mouth', set against chirij 'behind it'
culvachix: kulwachix — (inferred) he is met; the passive of kulwachij, with -x
tocota: tokota — (guess) strike down, bring to misery; not otherwise known, perhaps beside toq'ob' 'misery' (Brasseur togo-ta)
hupul: jupul — (inferred) face down; the word of jupulik 'face down' without -ik (Brasseur here reads hupul-oc 'mouth upward', the opposite)
xic: Xik — Xic; name of a lord of Xibalba, paired with Patan; Brasseur takes it as 'hawk'; kept as a name
rax: rax — green, raw, fresh; also 'sudden' (rax kamik 'green death', Brasseur 'mort subite')
xavah: xawaj — vomit; verb, with ch- + u- before it (chu xawaj kik' 'he vomits blood')
telelaon: telelaon — (guess) carry on the shoulder, bear as a load; not otherwise known, perhaps from tel 'carry on the shoulder' (compare ki telen)
cozih: kosij — (inferred) squeeze, throttle; after Brasseur ('étreindre'); Ximénez's plain c is respelled k
vculel: ukulel — (inferred) his throat, his neck; perhaps u- 'his' + kul 'neck' + -el; the toggle respells the letters
culmah: kulmaj — (uncertain) not otherwise known; read after Brasseur ('bringing it on him suddenly')
ꜩaixic: tzaixik — (inferred) being pursued; a passive in -x-ik, after Brasseur ('poursuivre')

ꜩuun: tzuun — (guess) leather, hide; perhaps the modern tz'um 'skin', the toggle respelling the letters; after Brasseur ('boucliers de cuir')

yachvach: yachwach — (guess) headgear or face-piece; with wach 'face'; after Brasseur
vachzot: wachsot — (guess) headgear or face-piece; wach 'face' + a second part not otherwise known; after Brasseur
cauubal: kauub'al — finery, adornment; the word of caubal 'beauty'
biye: b'iye — (inferred) going, journey; perhaps from b'e 'go' or b'in 'walk' (Brasseur 'leur voyage'); the reading of the last letter is doubtful
chouen: Chowen — Chouen; the name Junchowen without jun, as written; a day name

rahpop: rajpop — (inferred) mat-lord, a court title; r- 'its' + ajpop, aj- 'he of' + pop 'mat', after Brasseur ('captain'); the full sense is inferred

opon: opon — arrive (there); verb, arriving at a place away from the speaker (ul is 'arrive here')
chaaha: chaaja — (inferred) play (ball); chaaj 'play' + -a, the same word as chaah; the ending is inferred
caztah: k'astaj — (inferred) come alive, revive; k'as 'live' (root of k'aslem 'life') + -taj 'become'; the restored k' is inferred from the known root

oponoc: oponoq — come, arrive there; opon 'arrive there' + -oq, ending after a verb of motion, as in petoq
tucur: tukur — owl; noun (Brasseur 'hibou'), used as a singular for the kind
chabi: Chab'i — Chab'i, 'arrow' in the owl's name Chab'i Tukur; chab' 'arrow' (inferred) + -i, after Brasseur; kept as part of a name
chab: chab' — (inferred) arrow; after Brasseur, who gives cha as 'word, arrow, arrow point'
copquic: kopkik — (guess) swift, speedy; not otherwise known, 'swift' after Brasseur ('as swift as an arrow'); respelled letter for letter
caꜫ: kaq' — (inferred) red; written with the tresillo, Brasseur reads gag 'fire'; the modern word for red is kaq, so only the letters are respelled
calem: kalem — (guess) not otherwise known; a doubtful reading (the third letter is a tall looped l, Brasseur's text garbled), left out of the English; respelled letter for letter
vlic: ulik — arrived here; ul 'arrive here' + -ik, ending at the end of a clause
carchah: Karchaj — Carchah; place name, in Nim Xob Carchaj, a ball court; Brasseur says a town near Cobán in the Verapaz; kept as a name
tacatoh: taqatoj — (inferred) sent, those sent; not otherwise known, taken from taq 'send' after Brasseur; respelled by the letters
vcholic: ucholik — (inferred) its ordering, in order; u- 'its' + chol 'set in a row, in order' + -ik; after Brasseur ('in the same order of speech')
ahalcana: Ajalq'ana — Ahalcana; name of a lord of Xibalba, written with plain c, the same lord as Ahalꜫana elsewhere, Ajalq'ana; kept as a name
achbilai: achb'ilai — (inferred) going along with; ach 'companion' (root of rach 'together with') + -b'il + -ai; the make-up is inferred

pixabah: pixab'aj — (inferred) charge, counsel; pixab' 'counsel, command' + -aj; used with kan to 'leave a charge behind'
can: kan — behind, remaining; adverb, from the root of kanaj 'remain, be left'
ho: jo — (inferred) we go, let us go; the verb 'go' (Brasseur names it Ho 'aller', with hin 'that I go', he 'that they go'); the person 'we' is inferred, the letters respelled
et: et — (guess) not understood; perhaps the et of uwetal 'its sign'; respelled letter for letter
culic: kulik — (guess) not understood; perhaps k- + ul 'arrive' + -ik, or, with Brasseur's k'ulic (his k = q), q- 'our' + ul + -ik 'our arrival'; respelled letter for letter
camol: k'amol — taker, one who takes; k'am 'take' + -ol, agent ending
toc: toq — (inferred) the end of petoq 'come' written apart (ke pe toq 'let them come'): the t of pet 'come' + -oq, the ending after a verb of motion
tacol: taqol — summoner, one who sends for; taq 'send' + -ol, agent ending
cana: kana — (inferred) left behind, remaining; the root of kanaj 'remain' with -a
xima: xima — (inferred) tied it, bound it; xim 'tie, bind' + -a; the ending is inferred, after Brasseur ('hang up')
ꜭohul: k'ojul — (inferred) where there is a hollow; k'o 'there is' + jul 'hollow' written as one word, after Brasseur (qo hul)
choconizah: chokonisaj — (inferred) use it; the verb of chokonisan: chokon 'be of use' + -isa 'make' + -j; the make-up is inferred
ꜩuan: tzuan — (inferred) make music; after Brasseur ('faites de la musique'), perhaps the su 'flute' of ajsu, though written with the tz ligature; ending -an for an action with no object
bixan: b'ixan — sing; b'ix 'song' + -an, ending of an action with no object
ziban: sib'an — (inferred) write, paint; presumably the tz'ib' 'write, paint' of ajtz'ib'enai, but written with the plain z, so respelled by the letters; ending -an for an action with no object
mecoh: meq'oj — (inferred) be warm, warm it; meq' 'warm' + -oj; after Brasseur (megoh, 'réchauffez'); the restored q' is inferred
ivatit: iwatit — your (pl.) grandmother; iw- 'your (pl.)' + atit 'grandmother, old woman'
quzquz: kuskus — (guess) grief, emotion; not otherwise known, 'grief' after Brasseur ('emotion'); respelled letter for letter
xbizonic: xb'isonik — (inferred) worry, grieve; b'ison 'grieve, worry' + -ik, with x- before it unclear; the form is not certain
xuluxuh: xuluxuj — (guess) not understood; perhaps a doubled xul 'go down'; respelled letter for letter
cumuc: kumuk — (guess) not otherwise known; respelled letter for letter
zivanub: siwanub' — (inferred) ravines, gorges; siwan 'ravine, gorge' + -ub', not otherwise known (perhaps a plural)
nuzivan: Nusiwan — Nuzivan; first part of the name Nusiwan Kul, a gorge; nu 'my' (Brasseur) + siwan 'ravine'; kept as a name
cuzivan: Kusiwan — Cuzivan; name of a gorge; ku + siwan 'ravine', 'gorge-ravine' after Brasseur (inferred); kept as a name
eco: eko — (inferred) pass, cross; after Brasseur (eqo, 'they passed'), taken as the verb of ekowik and of ik'ow 'pass'; respelled by the letters, the ejective not restored
halhal: jaljal — (inferred) churning, rushing; jal 'change' doubled, after Brasseur ('eaux bouillonnantes'); sense inferred
zimah: simaj — (guess) calabash tree; after Brasseur, who reads it with the name Cavizimah 'adorned calabash tree'; respelled by the letters
tocotahic: tokotajik — (guess) being hurt; tocot + passive -aj + -ik, after Brasseur (togotahic, 'without hurting themselves'); the root may be that of tocota 'strike down'
quiqui: kik'i — (inferred) of blood; kik' 'blood' + -i, in chi kik'i a 'at a river of blood' (Brasseur chi quiqi-a); a doubtful reading, the manuscript's qui qui joined as one word
xcucah: xkuk'aj — they drank; x- completive + k- (ki- 'they' before a vowel) + uk'aj 'drink', as in kuk'aj 'we drink'
xalcat: xalkat — (inferred) crossing, fork of roads; after Brasseur ('where four roads met'); respelled by the letters
ꜫaꜫa: q'aq'a — (inferred) red; a colour word in -a, written with two tresillos (Brasseur caka, 'rouge'); the modern word is kaq, so the letters are only respelled
queca: q'eqa — black; q'eq 'black', the root of q'equm 'darkness', + -a, as colour words take -a
quinicamo: kinik'amo — you take me; k- 'ongoing' + in 'me' + i- 'you (pl.)' + k'am 'take' + -o
ꜭhacatah: ch'akataj — (uncertain) it was brought low; the verb of chakataj 'brought low' written with ꜭh; it may be the verb ch'ak 'win'; not certain
taqueh: taqej — (inferred) follow, keep on; taken as the taquen 'keep on, follow' of an earlier part, after Brasseur (takeh)
popobal: popob'al — council place; pop 'mat' + -ob'al, noun of place, the place of the mat where lords sat
cautalic: kawtalik — (guess) set up, arranged; not otherwise known, 'set up' after Brasseur ('arrangés'); respelled by the letters
quihila: kijila — (inferred) greet, honour; not otherwise known, after Brasseur (gihila, 'adorèrent'); respelled by the letters
cala: kala — hail, greetings; a greeting, which Brasseur takes as 'clear, bright, open'; perhaps the calah 'clear' of earlier parts (inferred)
xeꜭhacovic: xech'akowik — (inferred) they answered; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'akow 'answer' + -ik; the root may be ch'a 'speak'
humuhub: jumujub' — (guess) roar with laughter, burst out laughing; after Brasseur ('éclataient de rire'); respelled by the letters
ꜩe: tze' — laughter, laugh; noun (the modern word for laughing)
humin: jumin — (guess) roar, make a great noise; the humin 'raise a tumult' of an earlier part, after Brasseur
chacomahic: chakomajik — (inferred) being victorious, winning; from chak 'beat, win' + -omaj + -ik, after Brasseur ('victors in their hearts')
ꜩeen: tze'n — laugh; tze' 'laughter' + -n, the verb; the doubled e marks a glottal stop
xeꜭhau: xech'aw — they spoke; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'aw 'speak'
caza: kasa — (guess) not otherwise known; perhaps k'as 'live, wake' (inferred), as in k'astaj; respelled letter for letter
ibate: ib'ate — your (pl.) rings; i- 'your (pl.)' + b'ate '(guess) ring'
ipachcab: ipachq'ab' — your (pl.) hand-guards (guess); i- 'your (pl.)' + pachq'ab' '(guess) a guard for the hand'
catanalah: k'atanalaj — (inferred) burning hot; k'atan 'hot' + -alaj; the restored k' is inferred
xyaic: xyaik — (guess) not otherwise known; perhaps ya 'give, put' + -ik, 'it was set'; respelled by the letters
pizcalih: piskalij — (guess) writhe, roll about; after Brasseur ('rolled about'); respelled by the letters
yacamaric: yakamarik — (guess) be eased, find relief; perhaps from yak 'lift, raise'; after Brasseur; respelled by the letters
valehic: walejik — (inferred) rising up, getting up; not otherwise known, after Brasseur ('voulant se lever'); respelled by the letters

culibal: kulib'al — (inferred) seat, sitting place; a noun of place in -ib'al, after Brasseur ('siège')
pichicharic: pichicharik — (guess) not otherwise known, 'wept (from laughing)' after Brasseur; respelled by the letters
xvinaquiriheic: xwinaqirijeik — it came into being; x- completive + winaqir 'come into being' + an ending -ijeik not otherwise known
vcumaꜩ: ukumatz — its serpent; u- 'its' + kumatz 'serpent', the serpent of Q'ukumatz
quiquib: kik'ib' — (inferred) their blood; kik' 'blood' + -ib', perhaps a plural; after Brasseur (quiqib)
baquib: b'aqib' — (inferred) bones; b'aq 'bone' + -ib', perhaps a plural; after Brasseur (bakib)
hix: jix — go (you, pl.); the verb 'go' for 'you (pl.)', as ho 'we go'; after Brasseur (h'yx)
yaoc: yaoq — to be given; ya 'give' + -oq, ending after a verb of motion
ichah: ichaj — your (pl.) torch; i- 'your (pl.)' + chaj 'torch, a splinter of resinous pine'
izic: isik' — your (pl.) cigar; i- 'your (pl.)' + sik' 'tobacco, cigar' (inferred k')

vpam: upam — its inside, its belly; u- 'its' + pam 'inside'

coloquic: kolokik — (guess) round; after Brasseur ('a round arrow'); respelled by the letters
zaquitoc: Saqitok — Zaquitoc; name of Xibalba's torch; saqi 'white' + tok, which Brasseur takes as 'flint' (inferred); kept as a name · Saqitok — the white flint knife of sacrifice (Brasseur 'un couteau de silex'), carried by the owls; kept as a name
hucul: jukul — (guess) sharp; a doubtful reading, after Brasseur ('very sharp'); respelled by the letters
yohyox: yojyox — (guess) not understood; perhaps yoj 'undo, take apart' doubled; respelled by the letters
chicou: chikow — (guess) not otherwise known; respelled letter for letter
ꜩihom: tzijom — (inferred) lit, kindled; the letters of tzij 'word', taken as 'kindle, light', after Brasseur ('allumée')
zic: sik' — tobacco, cigar; noun (inferred k', after Brasseur's note)
chocochoh: chokochoj — (guess) crouching, curled up; not otherwise known, after Brasseur ('curled up on themselves'); respelled by the letters
cahulhut: kajuljut — (guess) blazing; not otherwise known, after Brasseur (ca hulhut, 'the flame burst out'); respelled by the letters
ꜩiha: tzija — (inferred) light, kindle; tzij 'light, kindle' + -a, the verb of tzijom
quizic: k'isik — (inferred) being finished, burned out; k'is 'finish, end' + -ik
moloba: molob'a — (inferred) gather, bring back together; mol 'gather' + -ob'a; the ending is inferred
quiz: k'is — finish, end; verb (xki k'is 'they finished')
xha: xja — (guess) not explained; perhaps xa 'just' or a completive form; respelled by the letters
vtihobal: utijob'al — its trials; u- 'its' + tijob'al 'trial', tij 'try, test' + -ob'al, place or means of trying (after Brasseur)
quia: kia — (inferred) many; not otherwise known, after Brasseur ('of many different kinds')
molah: molaj — (inferred) heaps, gathering; mol 'gather' + -aj; sense inferred
tihobal: tijob'al — trial; tij 'try, test' + -ob'al, place or means of trying (after Brasseur)
xuxulim: Xuxulim — Xuxulim, in Xuxulim Ha 'Xuxulim House', the second house of trial; kept as a name; Brasseur's note takes it as the north wind or its shivering ('la bise ou le frémissement du vent du nord'), inferred
teu: tew — cold; noun (ꜩaꜩ chi teu vpam 'thick with cold its inside'; tew is the modern word)
xuruxuh: xuruxuj — (guess) a sound word, 'rattling' perhaps; not otherwise known, repeats its sounds (xu-ru-xuh); respelled letter for letter
caracoh: karakoj — (guess) a sound word, not otherwise known; repeats its sounds (ca-ra-coh); in cac caracoh, a doubtful phrase left out of the English (Brasseur zakcaracoh); respelled letter for letter
xurulah: xurulaj — (guess) a sound word, 'whistling' perhaps; not otherwise known, repeats its sounds (xu-ru-lah); respelled letter for letter
chupam: chupam — inside, within; chi + u- 'its' + pam 'inside' (the m spelling of chupan)
balami: B'alami — Jaguar (in B'alami Ja 'Jaguar House'); b'alam 'jaguar' + -i, joined to ja 'house'; translated as a description
quichouic: kichowik — (inferred) milling about, mingling; sense after Brasseur ('they mingled'); respelled by the letters
matat: matat — (guess) not otherwise known; read 'fiercely' after Brasseur ('with a fierce air'); respelled letter for letter
tit: tit — (guess) not otherwise known, perhaps 'teeth' or 'grin' (read qui tit 'their teeth(?)', 'bared their teeth'), after Brasseur ('grinning'); a doubtful reading (t and h look alike in the hand); respelled letter for letter
ꜩapim: tz'apim — (inferred) shut in, closed; participle of tz'ap 'shut, close' (Brasseur 'enfermés'); the modern word is tz'apij; also written ꜩapin
ꜩoꜩi: Tzotzi — Bat (in Tzotzi Ja 'Bat House'); tzotz 'bat' + -i, noun + -i + ja 'house', built like B'alami Ja; the modern word for the bat is sotz', so only the letters are respelled
ꜩoꜩ: tzotz — bat; noun (Brasseur zotz, 'chauves-souris'); respelled by the letters, since the modern form of Ximénez's word is not certain (sotz')
ꜩiꜩotic: tzitzotik — (guess) shrieking, screeching; a sound word, after Brasseur ('crying'); a doubtful reading (MS ꜩiꜩohic), decided with Brasseur; respelled by the letters
ꜩitilahic: tzitilajik — (guess) fluttering, beating the wings; a sound word, after Brasseur ('beating their wings'); a doubtful reading (MS ꜩih'lahic), decided with Brasseur; respelled by the letters
ropop: ropop — (inferred) fly about, flutter; after Brasseur ('voltigeant'); respelled by the letters
ꜩapin: tz'apin — (inferred) shut in, closed; the same word as ꜩapim, written with n; participle of tz'ap 'shut, close'
roo: Roo — (uncertain) its fifth; r- 'its' + o(o), taken as 'five' from its place in the list (inferred); Brasseur Roo; not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
chaim: Chaim — Chaim, in Chaim Ja 'House of Blades (?)', the fifth house of trial; cha 'blade, obsidian point' + -im (unexplained) + ja 'house'; 'House of Blades' is inferred (Brasseur's introduction 'la Maison des Lances d'Obsidienne'; his French here 'maison des combattants', his text Chayim-ha)
chaꜫol: chaq'ol — (uncertain) meaning not known, left in K'iche' in the English; a doubtful reading (a q-shaped letter taken as the tresillo, a blot on the next); Brasseur reads chakol (his k is plain q) and renders 'victors'
leloh: leloj — (guess) gleaming; not otherwise known; zac leloh re is a doubtful division; respelled by the letters
ꜩininic: tzininik — (guess) clashing, a sound word; after chi; the make-up is not known; respelled by the letters
yohohic: yojojik — (guess) grinding, a sound word; after chi; the make-up is not known; respelled by the letters
aon: Aon — (uncertain) 'where' (inferred), repeating apa after Brasseur, who renders 'where' twice; possibly a form of apa; not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
xhe: xje — (doubtful) a verb before yaoc, read 'went' (xhe yaoc 'that was given') after Brasseur, who reads x-be (xb'e); the manuscript has h; printed as written and respelled by the letters
xquec: Xkek — (uncertain) not understood, left out of the English; the letters are clear in the manuscript but Brasseur does not print it as a word; respelled by the letters
xvꜭhax: xuch'ax — was spoken to, was asked; x- completive + vꜭhax (ch'a 'speak' + passive -x, as in xe vꜭhax 'they were told'), here without the plural e-
quizo: k'iso — finish it, use it up; k'is 'finish, end' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb at the end of its clause (xca quizo 'we have used them up'; Brasseur ka qizo)
iꜫih: iq'ij — your day, your days; i- 'your (pl.)' + q'ij 'day, sun'; the span of their life, perhaps their lot (inferred); q-shaped letter read as the tresillo, after Brasseur (gih)
cup: kup — (guess) be cut open; not otherwise known, after Brasseur ('cut in the chest'); respelled by the letters
vevah: wewaj — (inferred) hide, be hidden; taken as eu 'hide' (as in euaxibal 'the place of hiding') + -ah, with a v- before it, perhaps v- 'it'; Brasseur reads x-ch'yv'euah and renders 'enseveli' ('buried'); respelled by the letters
ivach: iwach — your (pl.) face; i- 'your (pl.)' + wach 'face', possessed noun
puzic: pusik — (inferred) being sacrificed; puz 'sacrifice' + -ic, as in quix puzic 'you are sacrificed'; the sense of puz is not fully certain (Brasseur 'sacrifiés')
pucbal: Pukb'al — Pucbal, in Pukb'al Chaj, a place name; kept as a name; Brasseur takes it as 'the place where ashes are put down', pucbal a place noun in -bal (inferred)
vnimal: unimal — his elder (brother); u- 'his' + nim 'great' + -al (the nimal 'greatness' of earlier parts), set against vchac 'his younger brother' (inferred)
xmuquic: xmuqik — it was buried, he was buried; x- completive + muq 'bury' + -ik; passive
tiquil: tikil — (inferred) planted, standing; tik 'plant' (as in xchicatiquiba 'we shall plant') + -il; after Brasseur ('the tree in the middle of the road')
xvachin: xwachin — (inferred) it bore fruit; wach 'face, fruit' + -in made a verb, with x- completive, after Brasseur ('se couvrit de fruits')
choco: choko — (inferred) before it went in; ch- + ok 'enter' + -o, in maha choco 'not yet it enters'; respelled by the letters
chuxol: chuxol — in among, among; chi + u- 'its' + xol 'among', relational noun
zima: sima — calabash tree, calabash (round fruit); Brasseur 'tzima'; the manuscript has plain z, so the toggle respells the letter as written; the modern word is presumably tz'ima'
cohcha: kojcha — we say, we call; k- 'ongoing' + oj 'we' + cha 'say' (Brasseur koh cha)
xumaihah: xumaijaj — he marvelled at it; x- completive + u- 'he' + maijaj 'marvel at' (inferred), singular; respelled by the letters
colocac: kolokak — (guess) round; perhaps the coloquic 'round' of the last part, after Brasseur (colocak); respelled by the letters
hunam: junam — alike, the same; jun 'one' + -am (inferred); Brasseur 'of the same kind'
caiih: kaiij — (inferred) look at (it); in qui caiih 'they look at it', after Brasseur (qui cayih, 'lorsqu'ils allaient le considérer'); a doubtful reading (no descender for a y); respelled by the letters
xux: xux — it became; x- completive + ux 'become'
xubanic: xub'anik — it was done, it happened; x- completive + u- + b'an 'do' + -ik (inferred)
chupuvic: chupuwik — (guess) pick, take; not otherwise known (perhaps ch- + upuv + -ic); the sense is a guess from context; respelled by the letters
naipu: naypu — likewise, also; nai + pu, as naipuch is naypuch; written as one word
catah: kataj — (inferred) forbid; after Brasseur ('forbidding one another'); respelled by the letters
hunamatal: junamatal — made alike, one with; junam 'alike' + -atal, participle of state (inferred)
xuta: xuta — he heard it, she heard it; x- completive + u- 'he, she' + ta 'hear'
capoh: q'apoj — maiden, young woman; noun, written with plain c where Brasseur reads gapoh (his g is ꜫ); the q' is restored (inferred)
roponic: roponik — her arrival, her coming; r- 'her' + opon 'arrive there' + -ik, verbal noun
vmeal: umeal — his daughter (a man's daughter); u- 'his' + meal; modern mi'al, the toggle keeps Ximénez's vowels; possessed noun
arecut: arek'ut — this then, so then; are 'this is' + cut 'then' written as one word
xquic: xkik' — Xquic, the maiden's name; Brasseur takes it as the prefix x (ix), which makes a woman's name, + quic 'blood' or 'rubber' ('la Femme-Sang ou la Gomme-Noire'), inferred; kik' 'blood' is the known word; kept as a name
ꜩihox: tzijox — is told, being told; the passive of tzijoj 'tell' without -ik (ta chi ꜩihox chic 'when it is told again')
chumaihah: chumaijaj — he or she marvels at it (inferred); ch- + u- 'he, she' + maijaj 'marvel at', after Brasseur; verb
quinaoh: kinaoj — (guess) 'go', in ma quinaoh vila 'shall I not go and see'; doubtful division, quin- is k- + in 'I' (inferred) and the rest is not clear; respelled letter for letter
quz: kus — (inferred) sweet, savoury; after Brasseur ('savoureux'), plain qu where he reads guz; adjective (quz vvach 'sweet its fruit')
xapon: xapon — he arrived there, she arrived there; x- completive + apon 'arrive (away from the speaker)'
hiiaa: jiiaa — ah!; a cry of wonder, printed as written (Brasseur Hiyaa); interjection
naquipe: naqipe — what is; the naquipa of earlier parts written with e
vachin: wachin — it bears fruit; wach 'fruit' made a verb with -in (inferred), the xvachin of the last part
laquita: lakita — (guess) 'if'; not otherwise known, sense taken from Brasseur; respelled letter for letter
chup: chup — (guess) pick, pluck; after Brasseur ('cueille'); the same letters give chupel 'put out'; verb
colocoxinac: kolokoxinaq — made round (inferred); coloc 'round' + -inac, the ending of a completed state, after Brasseur ('ces boules rondes'); participle
cabtac: q'ab'taq — arms, branches (of a tree); q'ab' 'arm, hand' + -tac, the plural; noun (chu cabtac che 'on the branches of the tree')
chaliquiba: chalikib'a — stretch it out (inferred); ch- (command) + a- 'you' + liq 'stretch, spread' + -iba, after Brasseur ('étends'); verb
xuliquiba: xulikib'a — he stretched it out, she stretched it out (inferred); x- completive + u- 'he, she' + liquiba (see chaliquiba)
vvi: uwi — her, in uwi ki q'ab' 'her right hand'; u- 'her' + wi, part of the word for the right hand (vi qui cab)
piꜩ: pitz — (guess) a squirt, a spurt; not otherwise known, 'spat with force' after Brasseur (chi piꜩ ca ban 'it is done with a squirt'); respelled letter for letter
xril: xril — he saw it, she saw it; x- completive + r- 'he, she' (the form before a vowel) + il 'see'
xunicoh: xunikoj — (inferred) she looked closely at it, examined it; after Brasseur ('jetant un coup d'oeil curieux'); nicoh is not otherwise known; verb
retal: retal — its sign; r- 'its' + etal 'sign', possessed noun (xa retal 'only its sign')
chub: chub' — spittle; noun, as in uchub'; with nu 'my' (nu chub 'my spittle')
caxah: kaxaj — slaver, saliva; noun, plain c kept, a couplet with chub' (nu caxah 'my slaver')
chocon: chokon — serve, be of use; verb, the choconic of an earlier part (mahabi ca chocon 'it is of no more use')
chuxibih: chuxib'ij — it frightens; ch- + u- + xib'ij 'frighten', the verb of an earlier part
vbaquil: ub'aqil — its boniness, its bones; u- 'its' + b'aq 'bone' + -il, the abstract ending
naol: naol — one who knows, a wise man (inferred); na 'know, feel' + agent -ol, after Brasseur ('artiste'); noun
ahuchan: ajuchan — speaker, orator (inferred); aj- 'one who' + uchan, taken as a word for speech, after Brasseur ('orateur'); respelled by the letters (this form with plain ch)
ꜩacatahic: tzakatajik — being completed, fulfilled (inferred); tzak 'complete' with a passive in -atah + -ik; respelled by the letters
chupel: chupel — put out, extinguished (inferred); taken from chup 'go out' as a fire goes out, after Brasseur; respelled by the letters
maixel: maixel — destroyed, annihilated (inferred); taken from mai 'destroy (?)', after Brasseur ('s'anéantisse'); respelled by the letters
ahuꜭhan: ajuch'an — speaker, orator (inferred); the same word as ajuchan written with the ꜭh letter; the modern form is not known, so the toggle follows the letters
canahic: kanajik — remaining, shall remain; kanaj 'remain' + -ik (xa xchi canahic 'it shall only remain')
vmial: umi'al — his daughter; u- 'his' + mi'al 'a man's daughter', the glottal stop restored (the same word as umeal); possessed noun
vꜩalihic: utzalijik — its/her returning; u- + tzalij 'return' + -ik, verbal noun
xbiyx: xb'iyx — it was said, was told; x- completive + b'iyj 'say' + passive -x (Brasseur's OCR x-bivx)
ral: ral — her child, the child of a woman; r- 'her' + al; possessed noun (ral chupam 'her child inside her')
xzacat: xsakat — (guess) passed (of months); not otherwise known, after Brasseur ('six mois s'étant écoulés'); respelled letter for letter
vacaquib: waqaqib' — six; the modern word is waqib', here with an extra syllable (Brasseur vakakib); numeral
xnauachil: xnawachil — she was noticed (inferred); nau 'know' + vach 'face' + -il, after Brasseur ('elle fut observée par son père'); verb
catepuch: k'atepuch — then also; cate 'then' + puch 'also' written as one word
vnatahic: unatajik — her being noticed (inferred); nata 'remember, notice' + passive -ik, after Brasseur; verbal noun
meal: meal — daughter (a man's daughter); the modern word is mi'al, the toggle keeps Ximénez's vowels (nu meal 'my daughter'); noun
vhoxbal: ujoxb'al — her fornication; u- 'her' + jox 'lie with' + -bal, here the cause or means (inferred, after Brasseur 'pour son déshonneur'); noun
puzo: puso — sacrifice (someone) (inferred); pus 'sacrifice' + -o, the transitive ending (chi be puzo vi 'let one go to sacrifice her there')
alac: alaq — you (pl., respectful), sirs; the plural of lal 'you' (alac ahauab 'my lords'); pronoun
ahchoce: ajchoke — whose; ah- 'one who, owner' + choce 'whom (?)' (inferred, after Brasseur 'De qui est l'enfant'); pronoun
aval: awal — your child; a- 'your' + al; possessed noun
pam: pam — belly, womb, inside; noun (cha pam 'in your belly', ꜭo chi nu pam 'in my belly')
val: wal — my child; w- 'my' + al; possessed noun
hoxol: joxol — a wanton, one who fornicates (inferred); jox 'lie with' + agent -ol, after Brasseur ('une fornicatrice')
chec: chek — (inferred) carry her off; ch- (command) + ec, from ecah 'carry on the shoulders', after Brasseur's note; respelled by the letters
zel: sel — bowl, vessel (gourd bowl), after Brasseur ('un vase'); noun (chupan zel 'inside the bowl'); respelled by the letters
cololeh: kololej — (inferred) return; perhaps the same word as tzololej, written with plain c, after Brasseur ('soyez de retour'); respelled by the letters
tiquem: tikem — (inferred) taking up, lifting; qui tiquem 'their taking up', a verbal noun in -em, after Brasseur; respelled by the letters
chelem: chelem — (inferred) carrying, bearing on the shoulders; qui chelem 'their carrying', a verbal noun in -em, after Brasseur; respelled by the letters
cucaam: kukaam — (inferred) carrying it; k- + u- (singular) + kam 'take' with a long vowel, after Brasseur (cu caam); respelled by the letters
puzbal: pusb'al — instrument of sacrifice; pus 'sacrifice' + -bal, the instrument (puzbal re 'her instrument of sacrifice'); noun
chuꜩinic: chutzinik — it will come right, it can be; ch- + utzin 'succeed' + -ik (maui chuꜩinic 'it cannot be'), from the xuꜩinic of an earlier part
quinicamizah: kinikamisaj — you (pl.) kill me; k- + in 'me' + i- 'you (pl.)' + cam 'die' + -iza 'cause to die' + -h, after Brasseur; verb
hoxbal: joxb'al — (inferred) fornication, wantonness; jox 'lie with' + -bal (nu hoxbal 'my fornication'), after Brasseur ('déshonneur', 'crime'); noun
xaqui: xaki — (inferred) simply, merely; xa 'only' + qui, after Brasseur (xaki 'seul'); adverb
queque: keke — printed as written, presumably a slip for keje' 'thus' (MS quequetacut for quehe ta cut), the correction not certain; respelled letter for letter
ꜩololeh: tzololej — (inferred) return; taken as the ꜩalih 'return' of vꜩalihic (tzalij; modern tzolij), after Brasseur ('vous retournerez'); compare kololej with plain c; respelled by the letters
ꜩacuixtah: tzakuixtaj — (guess) make certain; a doubtful reading, the meaning not known, after Brasseur ('soyez formels'); respelled by the letters
vꜩaquic: utzakik — (guess) its completion; doubtful reading, taken from tzak 'complete', as tzakatajik (Brasseur 'manifestez-en l'accomplissement'); respelled by the letters
coloba: kolob'a — (guess) set it in place; kol 'set, put in place' (?) + -oba, the root perhaps of xucolo and colom; Brasseur leaves it out; respelled by the letters
ivochoch: iwochoch — your (pl.) home; iw- 'your (pl.)' + ochoch 'home', possessed noun
ivech: iwech — yours (pl.); iw- 'your (pl.)' + ech 'possession' (ivech ri quiꜩih hoxol 'the true wantons shall be yours')
holomax: jolomax — not understood; it has the letters of jolom 'head' + -ax; Brasseur takes it as 'to be at the head, to rule', or with quic as the name of an illness ('le sang seul passe contrat pour lui-même'); left in K'iche'
xelic: xelik — it came out; el 'go out' + -ik, with x- completive (xelic xcul pa zel 'it came out and ran into the bowl')
xuvon: xuwon — (guess) it thickened, coagulated; von is not otherwise known, after Brasseur ('elle se coagula'); respelled by the letters (xuvon rib 'it thickened itself')
iiꜩ: iitz — (guess) welling out; a doubtful reading (two minims before the ꜩ, Brasseur yitz), 'welling out' after Brasseur ('jaillissant'); respelled by the letters
vquiquel: ukik'el — her blood; u- 'her' + kik' 'blood' + -el; possessed noun
xucolo: xukolo — (guess) it set, it congealed there; after Brasseur ('il se figea là'); col may be the root of kolob'a; respelled by the letters
ꜫaꜫluhluh: q'aq'lujluj — (inferred) glistening red; q'aq' 'red' + luhluh, a doubled ending of appearance, after Brasseur (cakluhluh 'brillante, rougeâtre'); respelled by the letters
colom: kolom — (guess) set, lying; as xucolo, not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
xcopcot: xkopkot — (guess) became renowned; not otherwise known, after Brasseur ('l'arbre devenait célèbre à cause de la jeune fille'); no person prefix; a passive 'was cut' would fit the grammar but has no support; respelled by the letters
xubinaah: xub'inaaj — he named it (inferred); b'i' 'name' + -naah, after Brasseur ('surnommé'); verb
locox: lokox — (inferred) be loved; not otherwise known, after Brasseur ('vous serez aimés', logox); respelled by the letters (quix locox vi 'you shall be loved there')
beba: b'eb'a — (guess) go; b'e 'go' + -ba, in xca beba 'we are going (?)' (x- + qa- 'we'); a doubtful reading, the b as written; respelled by the letters
naba: nab'a — (guess) not known; in ca naba acan oc 'we shall go up (?)', a doubtful reading; respelled by the letters
bin: b'in — walk; verb (xa ca bin apan oc 'just walk away')
yaix: yaix — (inferred) give, set; from ya 'give, put', the ending not clear; in ca yaix tah 'we shall set (it)', qa- 'we'; respelled by the letters
vꜫexevach: uq'exewach — its stand-in face, the likeness; uq'exel 'its replacement' joined to wach 'face' (read with Brasseur's gexevach); noun
zelevachin: selewachin — (guess) waiting and watching; not otherwise known, it contains wach 'face, eye', after Brasseur ('dans une attente inquiète'); respelled by the letters
xuchuieh: xuchuiej — (guess) he lifted it; after Brasseur ('il le souleva délicatement'); respelled by the letters
turur: turur — (guess) welled, spread; not otherwise known, a doubtful reading (first letter overwritten), 'welled' after Brasseur ('commença à se répandre'); respelled by the letters
comah: komaj — comah, not otherwise known; left in K'iche' (turur rih chi comah 'its surface welled with comah'); respelled by the letters
luu: luu — (guess) stir up; not otherwise known, 'stir up' after Brasseur ('Avivez bien les braises') (chi luu vvach q'aq' 'stir the face of the fire')
coc: kok — (inferred) smell, fragrance; after Brasseur ('commencé à sentir l'odeur'); respelled by the letters
yacatah: yakataj — (inferred) rise, be lifted; yac 'lift' + -atah, after Brasseur (xe quiz yacatah 'they all rose at once')
vzibel: usib'el — its smoke; u- 'its' + zib 'smoke' + -el; possessed noun
chiquichoh: chikichoj — (guess) entranced; not otherwise known (e chiquichoh vi canoc 'they stayed there'), after Brasseur ('tandis qu'ils demeuraient'); respelled by the letters
xebe: xeb'e — they went; x- completive + e 'they' + b'e 'go'
uabai: wab'ai — (guess) escort; not otherwise known, taken with wab'anel (e uabai rech capoh 'the maiden's escort'); respelled by the letters
xzalih: xsalij — (inferred) returned; x- completive + zalih, taken as tzalij 'return' written with the plain z (Brasseur x-zalih); no plural e- written; respelled by the letters
vabanel: wab'anel — (guess) escort, those who went with her; not otherwise known, perhaps the same word as wab'ai; respelled by the letters
moyvachixic: moywachixik — they were blinded, deceived (inferred); moy 'blind, dim' + vach 'face, eye' + passive -ix + -ik, after Brasseur ('se laissèrent aveugler')
chuh: chuj — chuh, in Chuj Q'aq' Che, the name of the red tree; Brasseur takes chuh as cochineal, the red dye insect (inferred); kept as a name
